question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"reappeared."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Reappeared"** means to appear again after a period of absence or disappearance. (पुनः प्रकट या पेश होना या दिखाई देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She **reappeared**__ suddenly.*
 
 
 
• The word is in the past tense, indicating that something that was previously absent has now returned.
 
• The sentence suggests that something has come back, but does not provide additional context.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

To my utter __astonishment,__ the little dark boy was striding __imperiously__ up and down the lawn while the white youngster walked abjectly behind him. “Get me a banana!” The little boy ran __into__ the house and __**reappeared**__ shortly.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Worried: **to think that something bad might happen or has happened. (किसी दुर्घटना की आशंका से चिंतित होना, फ़िक्रमंद होना)
 
• **Moved: **to change position or to put something in a different position. (स्‍थान बदलना या किसी वस्‍तु को अन्‍य स्‍थान पर ले जाना, हिलना या हिलाना; खिसकना या खिसकाना)
 
• **Exited: **to leave a place. (प्रस्‍थान करना, विलोपन करना)
